26:## Round 4b — Ultrasound entry, impression from the doctor's choices (owner 2026-11-01, D22)
27-Owner words: ultrasound B; impression: remove all the ready-made options and keep the ones from my choice, plus the editable text box. Scope of this round: impression, the live "report so far" line and "Fill normal scan". NOT in this round (needs owner sign-off on clinical reference numbers): stepper rows with typical biometry ranges. Existing cards, fields and testTags stay.
28-
29-Q210 (model/ClinicalModels.kt) ONE pure function `fun ultrasoundImpressionFromChoices(fetalNumber: String, presentation: String, placentalSite: String, amnioticFluid: String): String`. Blank or unknown values are skipped; nothing is invented (no "live", no "normal" unless chosen). Phrases in this order joined by ", ", first letter upper-case, ending with ".": fetal number Singleton -> "singleton pregnancy", Twins -> "twin pregnancy", Higher order -> "higher-order multiple pregnancy"; presentation -> "<lower-case value> presentation" (e.g. "cephalic presentation"); placental site Previa -> "placenta previa", otherwise "<lower-case value> placenta" (e.g. "anterior placenta", "low-lying placenta"); amniotic fluid Normal -> "normal amniotic fluid", Oligohydramnios -> "oligohydramnios", Polyhydramnios -> "polyhydramnios". Example: ("Singleton","Cephalic","Anterior","Normal") = "Singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation, anterior placenta, normal amniotic fluid." All blank = "".
30-Q211 (model/ClinicalModels.kt) ONE pure function `fun mergeImpression(existing: String, generated: String): String`: generated blank -> existing; existing blank -> generated; existing already contains generated -> existing; otherwise existing.trimEnd() + "\n" + generated. The doctor's own text is never overwritten.
31-Q212 (model/ClinicalModels.kt) three constants `const val NORMAL_FETAL_NUMBER = "Singleton"`, `const val NORMAL_PRESENTATION = "Cephalic"`, `const val NORMAL_AMNIOTIC_FLUID = "Normal"` (placenta and numbers are never pre-filled).
32-Q213 (ui/ClinicalPresets.kt) `commonUltrasoundImpressions` is deleted.
33-Q214 (ui/UltrasoundEditor.kt)
34-  a) The `QuickPresetChips` with tag prefix `impressionPreset` is removed. The editable `impression` text box (tag `impression`) stays.
35-  b) Under the text box a button `impressionFromChoices` "From my choices" calls `ultrasoundImpressionFromChoices` with the four draft values and sets IMPRESSION to `mergeImpression(current, generated)`; disabled while the generated text is blank or `enabled` is false; 48 dp.
36-  c) At the top of the form a card `ultrasoundLiveSummary` "Report so far" shows `ultrasoundImpressionFromChoices(...)` of the current choices, or "Nothing chosen yet" when blank (same function, no second copy).
37-  d) Two buttons `fillNormalScan` "Fill normal scan" and `clearFindings` "Clear findings": fill sets fetal number, presentation and amniotic fluid to the three NORMAL_ constants ONLY where the field is still blank, never touches placenta, numbers or impression; clear sets the four choices to blank only (numbers, impression, photos untouched). Both disabled when `enabled` is false.
38-  e) Theme colours only, 48 dp targets, strings in strings.xml (no new hard-coded visible English except existing style), no "Codex" wording.
39-Static checks (.agents/checks/check_r4b.py; strip comments; main sources only):
40- S120 `commonUltrasoundImpressions` and `impressionPreset` absent from main and androidTest/test; `fun ultrasoundImpressionFromChoices` and `fun mergeImpression` each defined once in ClinicalModels.kt.
41- S121 UltrasoundEditor.kt contains the testTags `impressionFromChoices`, `ultrasoundLiveSummary`, `fillNormalScan`, `clearFindings`, and still `impression`; it calls ultrasoundImpressionFromChoices and mergeImpression and references NORMAL_FETAL_NUMBER, NORMAL_PRESENTATION, NORMAL_AMNIOTIC_FLUID.
42- S122 the string literals "Singleton pregnancy" style phrases ("pregnancy,", "amniotic fluid") are not duplicated outside ClinicalModels.kt in main sources (one place for the wording).
43-Unit (JVM): NEW model/UltrasoundImpressionTest.kt: the example above; each placental site; Previa wording; Twins/Higher order; every fluid; partial choices (only presentation); all blank; unknown value skipped; mergeImpression four cases plus idempotence (merging twice changes nothing).
44-Gate: LINT-errors, whole unit suite, compile debug/release/androidTest, STATIC-r4b; then the orchestrator runs the emulator suite.
